title: President's PhD Scholarships
program_type: Centrally funded doctoral scholarship scheme for new PhD entrants
duration: 3.5 years of funding for a PhD place
description: The scholarship applies to both full- and part-time study.

title: UCL Global Master's Scholarship
duration: One year (50% in each year for two-year full-time programmes)
description: The UCL Global Master's Scholarship awards GBP 15,000 for one year to up to 85 students from any country outside the UK who are eligible for the Overseas fee rate, come from a lower income background, and have submitted a complete UCL admission application for a full-time Master's degree in 2026/27. Five awards are ring-fenced for students from India and one for a student from Japan as part of the Musubi Global Master's Scholarship. The award is applied first to tuition fees, with any remainder paid in three equal instalments towards maintenance. The 2026/27 deadline was 5pm BST on 7 May 2026.

title: UCL Humanitarian Scholarship
program_type: Humanitarian scholarship for conflict-displaced postgraduate students
duration: Tenable for one year, unless the full-time programme is two years in length
description: The UCL Humanitarian Scholarship enables students at serious risk and/or displaced due to armed conflict to pursue full-time Master's study at UCL. Up to three awards are available for 2026/27, each covering full tuition fees, a maintenance payment of approximately GBP 20,000 and an allowance for the Immigration Health Surcharge, visa fees and one return flight. Selection is on financial need, and applications close at 5pm BST on 7 May 2026 via the International Master's Awards form.

title: LSE PhD Studentships
official_source: London School of Economics and Political Science
duration: Tenable for four years, renewed annually subject to satisfactory academic performance
description: LSE offers LSE PhD Studentships to new PhD students alongside LSE DTP ESRC Studentships. The awards are open to high calibre students of all nationalities studying across all research areas at the School, are tenable for four years, and cover full fees and an annual stipend of GBP 23,805 with annual renewal subject to satisfactory academic performance.
